# Execution boundary [invariant]
This is an Exec coordination wake. Inspect company state and repositories only to frame and dispatch the outcome; use ordinary Restless CLI to update the factual actor, team, and Work graph, and update only Exec continuity files under /company/org/exec when needed. Do not edit application or repository files, create a candidate artifact or test output, run a productive repair, or claim a produced outcome in this wake. If the owner input requires productive execution, first inspect the current standing team leads and reuse a lead whose charter already covers the outcome; commission new capacity only when no such role exists. Send exactly one accountable lead a direct charter with the required repository coordinates and expected proof; the lead creates Staff-owned Work and supervises its Attempt. When the owner names a concrete output path or URL, preserve that exact locator in the charter rather than combining it with prose. Then quiesce. Any product file, screenshot, test result, or output created directly by this Exec wake is not an attributable outcome and must not be presented as one.

# Recent conversation in this focus [historical context; owner lines are owner-authored, your lines are prior claims]
- owner message 1: Begin EXP-11 from exact clean baseline commit 84ff1745b29267708599e94036ec6f7a2a7e0457, tree 25733ead6eb7c83221048d323838a5cadc2a235e. Fresh headless host/client and one fresh native OS-input delivery pass are retained under /company/outputs/exp11/baseline; a separate clean-runtime native run intermittently failed when the crate was released behind the truck and could not be recovered, so do not assume the scripted happy path proves robustness. Founder evidence is only: A/D feels reversed relative to the view and apparently solid truck geometry has no real collision behavior. Delegate once to one accountable non-producing Game Product lead and return to availability. The lead must supervise one end-to-end gameplay Staff worker by default, diagnose and prioritise foundational playability, require real physics/collision and view-relative controls, preserve multiplayer authority, and iterate only from exact executable or independent native evidence. Prepare a genuinely playable compact vertical slice and exact founder review target; do not broaden into content, weaken the frozen outcome, publish, deploy, or promote into the source company.
- you message 3: EXP-11 has begun from the exact clean baseline you specified — I verified the commit and its tree match before dispatching, and your retained baseline evidence is in place.

I have delegated the whole outcome once to an accountable Game Product lead, who supervises without producing: one end-to-end gameplay Staff worker by default, diagnosing and prioritising from the game itself, executable checks, and independent native playtests. The charter freezes the founder evidence you reported (reversed-feeling A/D, truck geometry without real collision), treats the unrecoverable crate-release failure as a first-class robustness requirement rather than polish, requires view-relative controls, real physics/collision, host-authoritative multiplayer state, recovery without soft locks, clean positive and negative network probes, and preservation of the current assets and route. All work stays local and private: no publishing, deploying, purchases, or promotion into the source company.

Nothing further is needed from you now. You will be brought one exact, runnable founder review target when the compact slice is genuinely playable, or a real blocker if one stabilises first.

One valid clean-room player picked up and recovered the crate, drove to visible truck z 40.0, exited and searched the endpoint, but every plausible E unload attempt re-seated it; Mission stayed IN PROGRESS and crate stayed CARRIED BY YOU. A separate arm physically transported a free crate to z 40.0 near the cab, but repeated E selected the overlapping driver-seat hotspot rather than the nearby crate; that arm later became infrastructure-invalid, so treat only this repeated interaction observation as supporting evidence, not a second verdict. Delegate to the accountable Game Product lead and commission the smallest revision that makes completion naturally discoverable: in the destination context, unload a carried crate before considering seat entry; when on foot near a free crate and the cab, pickup must win over seat; show a clear player-visible interaction target/prompt and destination guidance. Preserve authoritative multiplayer semantics, collision behavior, ordinary controls, negative unload rejection, and recovery. Re-run the full deterministic gate batch plus a fresh native action→capture loop, commit a clean candidate, and report the exact commit and evidence locators. Exec must remain coordinating only.
- you message 20: The completion path is being revised before any founder review. I have directed the existing Game Product lead to supervise the smallest change that makes unloading discoverable at the destination, gives a nearby crate priority over the driver seat when on foot, and makes the current interaction and destination clear to the player.

The revision must preserve the established multiplayer authority, physical collision, ordinary controls, negative unload rejection, and recovery behavior. It will return only with a clean committed candidate, the full existing deterministic checks, and fresh native evidence showing the interaction priorities and a completed delivery. Nothing is needed from you now; I will bring back an exact review target only if the lead’s evidence supports it, or a stable blocker if one arises.
<!--restless-intent:{"kind":"direction","summary":"Completion-path ambiguity on the current candidate has been delegated to the existing Game Product lead for the smallest evidence-backed revision and proof."}-->

- owner message 33: A fresh exact-Sol clean-room native referee has superseded the prior acceptance of candidate 09fe09d30c65b811c0904508525a6ab8af02145c. The immutable blind evidence is mounted read-only at /company/inputs/exp11-referee-r9, especially 031-crate-unloaded.png, action-trace.txt, observations.txt, verdict.txt, and window-routing.txt. Treat this as a production defect, not a referee implementation prescription. Exec must delegate to the existing non-producing Game Product lead and return to availability. Preserve evidence and commit the repaired candidate; do not publish or claim founder acceptance.
Work this turn using the actor contract and current company state in your system context. If the owner wrote, interpret and reply through the stated conversation contract. Stop when this Exec wake's coordination or bounded executive work is done.
